title: Whats your favorite place in mall world?
content: I’ll try to describe my favorite part of town. It’s past the college dorms, I go on a dirt road and pass a peaceful town on the shore. Once I see the beach, I know I am close. I have a beach town by the ocean, which is nice, but my absolute favorite place is the lake house. It’s a large, mostly glass structure. Huge vaulted ceilings, hardwood floors, and marble countertops. It’s a house that’s been owned for generations and people leave things behind, I often find random books, papers and other things in the rooms. There’s always people I know IRL there including friends and family. There’s a deck that brings us right down to the beach. We can go kayaking or swimming in the lake, and there is a little island across the way we sometimes paddle to. I’ve spent a lot of pleasant time there, and it’s always a warm and inviting feeling. Anyone else have a favorite spot in mall world?
